summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new MercadoProp Portal de Escribanías feature (/escribanos, /escribanos/panel, /escribanos/carpeta/:resId). Drove the full pre-requisite consumer flow (home → property p1 → mobile reserve → 3-step verification → escrow → notary n1) to seed a folder, then exhaustively validated login, panel stats, tabs (Carpetas/Agenda), folder detail with 5-stage checklist, retention table with MercadoProp 1%+1% commission, AI Assistant (welcome + 3 chips + free text + close), guards, logout, multi-notary (n2 empty state), persistence, and regression of marketplace home + profile. All 12 features in the request passed.

ui_bugs.issue: The `ai-assistant-open` floating button (fixed bottom-5 right-4) is overlapped by the preview-only `#emergent-badge` (bottom-right) on mobile 390x844 viewport. Real users can still tap it (badge is small and not perfectly aligned), but Playwright reports pointer-event interception unless force=True or the badge is hidden. Same root-cause type as the iteration_1 mobile action bar overlap and is purely a preview-environment artifact (badge not present in production).

Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The `option` body uses interpolated text `${n.name} — ${n.titular}` which the visual-editor wrapper instruments by injecting <span style='display:contents'>, producing an invalid DOM tree inside <option> and a React hydration warning. Not a runtime/user-facing bug, but should be flagged for the source-instrumentation tooling (the file itself is fine).

action_items: OPTIONAL: raise z-index of `.ai-assistant-open` floating button or position it slightly higher (e.g. bottom-20) on mobile so the Emergent preview badge does not intercept clicks. Not blocking — user-facing UI works in production.
OPTIONAL: review the NOTARIES option rendering to suppress the React hydration warning emitted by the dev-tools instrumentation.
critical_code_review_comments: NotaryPanel computes `totalRetentions` via `f.ret.items.find(i => i.highlight).amount` — if a future change removes the highlight flag this throws TypeError. Add `?.amount ?? 0` guard.

NotaryFolder uses `setOpenStage(isOpen ? -1 : si)` so collapsing the currently-open stage sets it to -1; the toggle UX works but means clicking the active stage header hides every task list (no open stage at all) instead of just collapsing visually. Acceptable but worth confirming intentional.
AppContext.notaryLogin/folderTasks share the same `mercadoprop_state_v1` localStorage blob with no schema versioning — same observation as iteration_1.
NotaryAssistant FAB does not have an aria-label and uses only `Sparkles` icon + text; screen readers will read 'Asistente IA' which is fine, but the close button (icon-only X) has no aria-label.
NotaryFolder's STAGES iteration uses `for (ti in range(4))` style only in tests; in code the data file allows variable task counts (1..4). Verified at runtime.

rca_of_the_issue: No blocking issues. The only friction encountered during automation was the preview-environment Emergent floating badge intercepting the AI Assistant FAB on mobile — identical class of issue called out in iteration_1 for the mobile reserve CTA. Mitigation: force=True click or DOM removal of #emergent-badge before clicking. Not a code defect; the badge is injected only in the Emergent preview shell and not in production.
